## Summary

<!-- One sentence describing the user-visible change. No headers above this line — the release-notes generator picks the first non-header paragraph. -->



## Checklist

- [ ] This change stays within the project's supported scope.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated if supported behavior changed.
- [ ] Docs were updated if user-facing behavior changed.
- [ ] This does not add a provider-specific custom API without prior maintainer approval.
- [ ] If an AI coding agent made this change, it loaded AGENTS.md and followed its testing rules, the live Home Assistant suite as appropriate.
- [ ] If an AI coding agent made this change, the full diff was reviewed independently, and the latest review is recorded under Code review.

## Details

<!-- Optional, except that a PR that fixes an issue puts Closes #N here: implementation notes, design choices, links to related issues/PRs. -->



## Accepted trade-offs

<!-- Behavior this change deliberately leaves as it is, and limits it accepts, each with its reason, so reviewers and later changes don't take them for bugs: for example a case it still handles as before, or a check it leaves out on purpose. Write "None" if there are none. -->



## Code review

<!-- Required for a PR made with an AI coding agent, welcome on any other; CONTRIBUTING.md, "Have the change reviewed independently", has the policy. Record the latest independent review: what ran it and at what effort, the commit it reviewed, whether it covered the full diff from main or only what changed since the last full review, its result (clean, or which findings were fixed, accepted above, dismissed or left open), and what changed after it, if anything. Also keep every finding dismissed or still open from any review of this PR, each with why, and, if the latest review covered only recent changes, the last full review's commit and result. Aim for a clean latest review with nothing changed after it; when that isn't so, say why. -->
